label: 블러드 녹턴 3D
note: 3D app update. Fire is redone: one continuous blaze on burning walls, roofs and wrecks instead of rows of separate flames, braziers burn over glowing coals, floor candles carry small living flames. Jars, pots, urns, crates and barrels stand in every area and break in one hit (clay also when rolled through) with 3D pieces and their own sounds; they drop silver coins, healing and resonance, and the coin count shows on screen and is kept in the save. Fixed: the cemetery gate did not open in either night even with the key, which stopped the story after the first return to tonight; it opens now. The 2D app is unchanged (462996).
